description:
The shared SQL/file loader at data_loading.py silently records 0 rows when
manifest-listed shard paths don't exist as files on disk (line 1972-1976).
This causes cryptic downstream query failures instead of an immediate,
actionable load error. Similarly, _load_single_file doesn't fully guard
against directory inputs or missing explicit single-file inputs, allowing
IsADirectoryError or silent skip behavior to propagate.

Root cause: stale Iceberg table directories (customer/, lineitem/) coexist
with valid manifest-tracked files. The exists() filter passes for directories,
but handlers can't load them. When all shards filter out, 0 rows is recorded
silently.

This is the highest-value fix because it protects users regardless of the
contamination source - stale Iceberg dirs, bad paths, permissions, etc.

anti_patterns.dont: leave explicit single-file manifest or benchmark-table paths on the legacy warn+return-0 branch

anti_patterns.why: raise errors instead, because silent failures cause cryptic downstream query failures
